verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents programmatic read access to account data. Its API lets you "pull data from Klaviyo to … sync to other systems," and the platform is accessible headlessly so people and agents can read Klaviyo data. Event retrieval is paginated at 200 per page with cursors, and requests are rate-limited, so a full exit means writing your own paginated extraction scripts rather than using a one-click export. missing for 10: a documented bulk or full-account export feature, explicit open export formats (e.g., CSV/JSON dumps), coverage of all data types (templates, flows, segments), offboarding/migration guidance, and independent corroboration of a complete data exit.
